workspace/__main__.py::S110.why: Window niceties at start (bring to front, never block a Windows shutdown, quiet when minimised); the app works without them. Not logged: an exception's text could carry names or paths (P3).

workspace/app.py::S110.why: Restoring the lid-close setting (retried while idle), the policy tick and the download-queue policy (tried again at the next tick), and an import clean-up step (the meeting is discarded or kept for next time); none may stop the app. Not logged (P3).

workspace/app.py::S606.why: os.startfile on the Hand off assistant's address, an https address checked by policy.valid_url (IT's, or the fixed default), only after the user clicks; Windows opens it in the user's browser and the app sends nothing (N2, #109).

workspace/app.py::S608.why: The IN clause is a fixed subquery string (the active versions); no outside value.

workspace/appcontainer.py::S110.why: Closing handles during clean-up; nothing else to do if that fails.

workspace/audit.py::S110.why: Closing the mirror file, and reporting an incident while handling another failure; the audit result stands without them. Not logged (P3).

workspace/audit.py::S314.why: Parses wevtutil's output for the app's own Event Log entries; a document type or entity declaration is refused before parsing (_entries), so no entity can expand.

workspace/audit.py::S603.why: wevtutil.exe by absolute path from the Windows system folder (system_program), with an argument list, a minimal environment and a time limit; the query names only the app's own fixed provider.

workspace/cleanup.py::S608.why: Only ? placeholders are joined into the IN list; the values are parameters.

workspace/gpu.py::S603.why: nvidia-smi by absolute path only (_nvidia_smi, never from PATH), fixed arguments and a time limit.

workspace/loopback.py::S110.why: Stopping a capture client, a stream that is opened again, and a notification callback; nothing here may stop a recording. Not logged (P3).

workspace/media.py::S110.why: After a failed import: removing the half-made meeting and writing its activity note; its folder is removed regardless. Not logged (P3).

workspace/media.py::S603.why: The decoder child on platforms other than Windows: the app's own Python with fixed arguments and no shell. Windows starts it in its sandbox instead (I2).

workspace/offline_guard.py::S110.why: Turning off onnxruntime's telemetry events where it is not installed, or is a build without the switch; the offline guard itself still applies (N1).

workspace/power.py::S110.why: Releasing power requests and handles, and a Windows callback that must never raise; nothing here may stop a recording ending.

workspace/recorder.py::S110.why: Stopping and closing an audio stream, and clean-up steps, as a recording ends; each runs whether or not the one before it failed.

workspace/setup.py::S110.why: A model check that fails ends as "The check could not be completed." (the state set before it); not logged (P3).

workspace/setup.py::S310.why: The GPU component download (download process only): https only, the address must start with the pinned prefix (gpu.DOWNLOAD_HOST), redirects only to the same host (_SameHost), size-limited, and the caller checks its SHA-256 (N2, I1).

workspace/shell.py::S110.why: Window-quietening steps (#196), the backend preload (check_backend loads it again and fails closed) and the alert guard (checked just below it, failing closed). Not logged (P3).

workspace/store.py::S608.why: Every identifier is fixed in the code or checked first: table names through _quoted_table (plain names only, #415 item 5), conditions through plain_condition (no quote, comment, subquery or content column) or fixed strings, and column lists from MEETING_STATE and CONTENT_COLUMNS; every value is a ? parameter.

workspace/update.py::S608.why: The table name must match _TABLE_NAME (a plain identifier) before it is quoted (#415 item 5); any other name is counted as content instead of read.
